objective: Implement the live Sign in with ChatGPT adapter and one-time Windows authorization CLI that will later activate the Astra reviewer bridge, while keeping all CI offline and preserving the zero-extra-spend boundary. Do not enable the reviewer workflow or perform the user's real authorization in this task.
constraints: USD 0 extra spend. No OPENAI_API_KEY, partner API key, separately billed API fallback, automatic credit enablement, or silent model substitution.
TASK-0004 must not edit .github/workflows files. The existing ChatGPT Plan Reviewer workflow stays disabled until a later trusted activation step.
Do not perform the user's real browser authorization in CI or during worker execution. Implement and test the adapter offline with fakes only.
Do not make live OpenAI requests from GitHub-hosted CI/regression.
Do not access or claim access to existing ChatGPT conversations or ChatGPT memory.
No local AI/video inference, cleanup mutation, merge, or auto-merge.
Astra remains reviewer-only; workers implement fixes.

Access/refresh/ID tokens, authorization codes, PKCE verifiers, cookies, credentials, and authorization URLs containing id_token_hint must never be committed, logged, uploaded, included in artifacts, PR comments, review history, or diagnostics.
Credentials and registration state must live outside the repository in protected host-local storage. Windows is the first target runtime.
Exact gpt-6-astra may be used only if the account-authorized model catalog exposes that exact identifier.
implementation_requirements: Implement a stable ext_agent_host_id abstraction. Support a persisted host identity suitable for the Windows self-hosted reviewer machine and do not regenerate it on each sign-in.

Implement authorization request construction for the open-source Sign in with ChatGPT flow with loopback redirect using 127.0.0.1, resource https://api.openai.com/v1, response_type=code, PKCE S256, fresh state, fresh nonce, and scopes openid profile email offline_access resource.invoke chatgpt.tokens.use.direct.
Implement a loopback callback abstraction that validates exact state and captures the issued client_id plus authorization code without logging them.
Implement token-exchange/refresh request builders as pure deterministic functions. Real HTTP transport must be injected behind an interface so CI uses fakes.

Implement ID-token verification behind a verification interface. Tests must exercise issuer, audience/client_id, nonce, expiry, and signature-verifier failures. Do not accept an unverified ID token merely by decoding it.
After successful sign-in, require the actually granted scope set to include chatgpt.tokens.use.direct and offline_access before marking plan sharing active.

Implement protected host-local registration/session storage abstraction. On Windows provide a concrete adapter that encrypts/protects secret credential material using OS facilities or a defensible host-protected mechanism, while keeping secrets outside the repository.

Persist issued client_id, stable host identity, stable account/profile label, granted scopes, token expiries, and credential material in the proper protected boundary. Do not expose raw credentials from status/report commands.

Implement serialized token refresh for one registration. Refresh request must use the issued client_id, current refresh_token and resource=https://api.openai.com/v1; omit scope to retain the grant. On success atomically replace stored credentials with the newest refresh token.
Implement failure-safe refresh rotation: if persistence of replacement credentials fails, do not report the session as successfully refreshed. Avoid two processes racing one rotating refresh token.
Implement model catalog parsing and exact gpt-6-astra enforcement. Similar names such as gpt-6-astra-preview must not qualify.

Implement a deterministic Responses API request builder for SIWC plan usage that enforces store=false and stream=true, sends required context in input/instructions, and rejects unsupported fields/stateful conversation identifiers before transport.
Implement streaming response assembly/parsing behind a fakeable transport boundary without persisting raw credentials or unsupported conversation state.

Map authentication/model/plan/network outcomes into explicit statuses compatible with TASK-0003, including BLOCKED_AUTH_REQUIRED, BLOCKED_NO_ASTRA, BLOCKED_PLAN_ALLOWANCE and a non-review infrastructure/network blocked state. 401/403 auth failures must not become REJECTED code verdicts. 429 plan/rate exhaustion must not enable paid fallback.

Implement a handoff function that accepts a live structured reviewer payload only after TASK-0003 immutable expected snapshot checks and then uses the existing TASK-0003 verdict/schema/idempotency/persistence gate rather than bypassing it.

Implement a Windows-friendly one-time CLI with commands such as init-host, sign-in, status, models and dry-run/self-check. Sign-in must require direct user interaction and must not be invoked automatically by CI.
Status/models output must be credential-free and safe to paste into ChatGPT/GitHub if needed.
Document the exact post-merge user steps needed to authorize once and configure the self-hosted reviewer later, but do not claim that live activation has occurred.
offline_test_requirements: No test may require internet, OpenAI credentials, ChatGPT account access, or a self-hosted runner.
Test stable host ID reuse and invalid host ID rejection.
Test PKCE S256 verifier/challenge and fresh state/nonce generation interfaces.
Test state mismatch and malformed callback failure before token exchange.
Test scope enforcement for missing chatgpt.tokens.use.direct, missing offline_access, and identity-only sign-in.
Test ID-token validation failures for issuer, audience/client ID, nonce, expiry, and signature verifier.
Test current access token versus expired access token paths.
Test successful rotating refresh token replacement and atomic persistence.
Test concurrent refresh attempts so exactly one refresh for a registration is active.
Test persistence failure after token refresh and ensure success is not falsely reported.
Test invalid/revoked refresh responses map to BLOCKED_AUTH_REQUIRED.
Test account/registration separation and client_id reuse for returning sign-in.
Test exact gpt-6-astra available and absent/similar-name model cases.

Test Responses plan request builder requires store=false, stream=true, no previous_response_id/conversation/background/metadata/user/temperature/top_p/max_output_tokens or other documented unsupported fields, and carries full required review context explicitly.
Test fake streaming response success and malformed/incomplete stream failure.
Test 401, 403, 429, 5xx and network failures map to blocked infrastructure/auth/allowance states without generating APPROVED/REJECTED or paid fallback.

Test synthetic access_token, refresh_token, ID token, auth code, PKCE verifier, cookies, bearer values, private keys and id_token_hint authorization URLs do not appear in logs/status/diagnostics/persistable public records.
Test live adapter cannot bypass TASK-0003 exact immutable snapshot/verdict/schema/idempotency gates.
Test no OPENAI_API_KEY code path, no conversation/history access, no local inference, no cleanup mutation, no merge/auto-merge.
acceptance_criteria: All TASK-0004 regression tests pass offline with fake transports/verifiers/storage.
The adapter can be reviewed and merged without performing a real sign-in.
A future Windows user can explicitly run the sign-in CLI to open browser consent and complete the loopback flow, but CI cannot trigger it.
No credential material is written inside the repository or emitted by safe status/diagnostic output.
Refresh rotation is serialized and atomic, with failure-safe persistence.
SIWC Responses request builder enforces current preview-compatible stateless request constraints.
Live reviewer payload handoff cannot bypass TASK-0003 exact-SHA/snapshot/schema/idempotency gates.
Zero-spend, no paid fallback, no conversations, no local inference, audit-only cleanup and no merge/auto-merge remain intact.
Review packet truthfully remains PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW until exact-head regression passes.
